meta.parties: De Silva Et Al. v. De Silva Et Al

rules.statement: A defendant seeking to file an answer without giving security must provide sufficient details in their affidavit to indicate a reasonable ground for the defense, beyond merely stating 'I owe nothing'.
rules.supporting_quote: "Doubtless, if it was true that you owed the man nothing as you swear that would be a good defence. But that is not enough. You must satisfy the Judge that there is reasonable ground for saying so."
